ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels; the surface is predominantly low-intensity black with high-intensity pixels restricted to distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) field across >95% of the visible surface area; high-contrast white clusters are mapped to the extreme left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an acute interior angle approximately between 40 and 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible continuous trailing edge with irregular, low-amplitude serrations and small semi-circular indentations scattered along both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature of the trailing edges, sweeping upward and outward to sharpened distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small jagged nicks and irregularities visible along the trailing edge of both lobes, particularly near the distal-right tip.
